worker_output.summary: Implemented galaxy map canvas rendering per design/ui-ux/wireframes/galaxy-map.md. Key changes: (1) src/ui/canvas/starmap.ts: New file with pure canvas drawing helpers — STAR_COLORS palette (all 6 star types), getMapTransform() (maps galaxy coords→pixels with padding), galaxyToCanvas(), hitTestStar() (click detection with radius), drawStarDot() (colored glow+core), drawSelectionRing() (dual-ring highlight), drawColonyRing() (empire-colored ownership ring), drawStarLabel(), drawFleetIndicator(). All functions are pure — no DOM queries, no store access. (2) src/ui/components/StarMap.ts: Refactored to use starmap.ts helpers. Now renders in 5 passes: selection ring → colony rings → star dots → fleet indicators → labels. Empire colors computed from empires.allIds order. Uses hitTestStar() for click detection. Dispatches SELECT_SYSTEM action. (3) src/ui/components/InfoPanel.ts: Full MOO1-accurate info panel with 4 states: empty (nothing selected), unexplored star, uncolonized planet (with size/type/specials), your colony (pop/factories/bases/shield/waste + production progress bar with block chars), enemy colony (empire name + estimated stats). (4) src/game/reducer.ts: Added SELECT_SYSTEM handler — sets ui.selectedSystem, clears ui.selectedPlanet and ui.selectedFleet on selection change. (5) src/ui/screens/GalaxyScreen.ts: Upgraded to proper full-screen view — auto-creates canvas if missing from HTML, applies .galaxy-screen class. All 4 acceptance criteria met: stars render at correct positions, star colors match spectral types, click selection dispatches SELECT_SYSTEM and highlights selected star, info panel updates on selection showing selected star data. TypeCheck: 0 errors. Tests: 411 passed (25 new).
